name: Separator Coefficient Ratio
definition: For positive separator coefficients $a_{p,i}$ and positive witness magnitudes $z_{c,i}$, take for every concept and minimal missing pattern the ratio of the weighted terms where the concept agrees with the missing pattern to the weighted terms where it disagrees. Let $R_C(a,z)$ be the maximum of these ratios, $T_C(a)=\inf_{z>0}R_C(a,z)$, and $\tau(C)=\inf_{a>0}T_C(a)$.
normalization: Coefficient rows may be normalized to sum one because row and witness rescaling leave every ratio unchanged. Empty numerators and the empty maximum are zero.
comments: Defined for every nonempty positioned binary class. The infima need not be attained. The threshold $\tau<1$ characterizes realizable ampleness; $\tau=0$ has a strict tropical term-dominance characterization. Whenever a union-closed orientation exists, $\tau(C)^2=\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}(C)$.
